description: Documentation markdown file providing instructions and information about managing OpenAI code interpreter containers using LiteLLM SDK, REST API, and OpenAI client, including usage examples and parameter explanations.

classes.name: ContainerObject
classes.description: Represents a container resource with properties such as ID, name, status, timestamps, and associated file IDs.

classes.name: ContainerListResponse
classes.description: Response object containing a list of containers along with pagination information.

classes.name: DeleteContainerResult
classes.description: Result object indicating success status of container deletion.

methods.name: create_container
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified parameters such as name, expiration, and optional file IDs or custom LLM provider.

methods.name: acreate_container
methods.description: Asynchronous version of create_container for non-blocking container creation.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of containers based on filtering, pagination, and sorting parameters.

methods.name: retrieve_container
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container by ID.

methods.name: delete_container
methods.description: Deletes a specified container by ID.
